title: Roveia CTA footer on a blue glow
description: A closing CTA and footer over a soft, blurred blue glow rising from below: a big centred two-line heading, a quiet sentence and a blue pill; then the wordmark, social icons and copyright on the left and three small link columns on the right, links turning blue on hover. Both halves fade and rise in on scroll.
notes: the glow is built from the theme's --glow, so it re-colours with the theme
CSS scroll-driven fade; all visible without support or with reduced motion
name: roveia-footer
